title: Android XR Spatial UI, Comfort, and Capability Fallback Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies android xr spatial ui, comfort, and capability fallback?
options: Use space only where it improves the task and guarantee complete capability-aware, comfortable, accessible non-spatial fallback.
questions.answer: Use space only where it improves the task and guarantee complete capability-aware, comfortable, accessible non-spatial fallback.

questions.prompt: An app running on Android XR must replace its normal 2D activity UI with spatial components.

questions.prompt: Why isolate XR APIs behind a capability boundary?
